entities.name: Okinawa Prefectural Peace Memorial Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Okinawa Prefectural Peace Memorial Museum  is a museum in Itoman, Okinawa. It was established on June 11, 1975. The Cornerstone of Peace, a monument similar to the Vietnam Veterans Memorial, is located here.
